title: 5 signs your bedtime is just a suggestion
format: Notes listicle, app on one point
why: Variant of 52 (1K views): same self-diagnosis listicle, new angle; app is the fix on the last sign.
caption: what time did you actually fall asleep last night? #bedtime #sleepschedule #screentime
check: closer: 'guilty of all 5'. Only if true for you

slides.title: 5 signs your bedtime is just a suggestion

slides.heading: you say _"i'll sleep at 11"_ every night
slides.text:
you're not setting a bedtime

you're setting a _starting point_

slides.heading: you get in bed _to scroll_, not to sleep
slides.top: bed is just the _comfiest place_ to be on your phone
slides.text: your brain now thinks bed means _feed_

slides.heading: your alarm math _keeps shrinking_
slides.top: "if i sleep now i get 7 hours"... _6 and a half_... _6_
slides.text: you've done this math _three times tonight_

slides.heading: your charger lives _next to your pillow_
slides.top: the phone sleeps _closer to you_ than anyone
slides.text: and it's _never_ the one that falls asleep first

slides.heading: bedtime has to _actually mean something_
slides.top: a reminder at 11 is _easy to swipe away_
slides.text:
so i made mine a lock. at bedtime my apps _shut off_

they open again in the morning, _once i'm up and walking_

slides.question: what time did you actually sleep last night? 👇
lines: the app is locturne, it's on the App Store
